finding: The capacity summary allows Go-style RPC names such as DeadlineExceeded. The runtime emits canonical names such as DEADLINE_EXCEEDED. The summary replaces these error classes with other and does not retain rpc.response.status_code.
limit: The discarded status cannot be reconstructed from the saved aggregate. These records cannot identify the cause of each failed RPC. This does not establish a defect in the emitted runtime signals.
